blocks.body: # Boundary-IoU experiment review by training geography

## Technical summary

**Do not pool these folders.** `Logs_france/` contains France-only training; `Logs/` contains Austria, Croatia, and Denmark. France's strongest boundary-BCE checkpoint is `w20_s012`; the same parameter set is also the only boundary-BCE result currently available for the three-country dataset. Differences between their absolute metrics describe different evaluation populations, not a model regression.

## Scope and comparison basis

Each row uses the maximum evaluation boundary IoU from the latest detected training session in its source log. France has a broad sweep; the three-country folder currently has only one matching boundary-BCE configuration, so within-dataset ranking is available only for France.

## Sigma 0.12 remains the France leader

With boundary weight 20 and distance weight 0.1, sigma 0.12 leads the France-only sweep at 0.3863 boundary IoU. Sigma 0.24 and 0.09 are close behind, while setting distance weight to zero reaches 0.3816. The mask-only baseline reaches 0.3469, so the leading boundary-BCE run improves peak boundary IoU by 0.0394 absolute (11.4% relative).

## The three-country run establishes a new baseline

For Austria–Croatia–Denmark, `w20_s012` peaks at boundary IoU 0.3591 and mIoU 0.6811. The mask-only baseline peaks at boundary IoU 0.3155 and mIoU 0.6672. The boundary-BCE configuration therefore improves peak boundary IoU by 0.0436 absolute (13.8% relative) while also improving mIoU by 0.0139.

## Limitations and uncertainty

The two folders differ in countries, image counts, and evaluation populations. Absolute metrics are therefore not directly comparable. Runs are single-seed peak-checkpoint results, so small differences may be training noise.

## Recommended next step

Run the same compact sweep on Austria–Croatia–Denmark: sigma 0.09, 0.12, 0.18, and 0.24 at boundary weight 20 and distance weight 0.1, plus sigma 0.12 with distance weight 0. Then select using the three-country validation boundary IoU only.

## Further questions

Does sigma 0.12 remain best across multiple seeds and per-country validation slices? A country-level breakdown would reveal whether the aggregate is dominated by Austria's larger sample count.

query.description: Reproduces reviewed rows parsed from latest sessions in Logs_france/ (France only), including the mask-only baseline.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('w20_s012',20.0,0.12,0.1,54,0.3591,0.6811),('mask_baseline',NULL,NULL,NULL,40,0.3155,0.6672)) AS t(config,boundary_weight,boundary_sigma,distance_weight,best_epoch,boundary_iou,miou) ORDER BY boundary_iou DESC
